list: Official 55 trophies as published on PlayStation Network, 18 November 2026
note: Names, descriptions and grades are PlayStation's own words, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles on 18 Nov 2026. Every guide below is written in our own words for this guide; where a method is not yet confirmed by any published guide it is marked UNCONFIRMED.

trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned. There is no shortcut: it needs the story, the 100% completion checklist, every side strand and every collectible counted below. PowerPyx rates the whole run about 200 hours at difficulty 4/10, with a single playthrough enough.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks when you finish the first main mission of Chapter 1, Gone Fishing. Just play the story; it pops on its own. (PowerPyx)
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks when Chapter 1 ends, after the first main mission of Chapter 2, What's in the Bag?. Keep playing the story. (PowerPyx)
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks when Chapter 2 ends, after the first main mission of Chapter 3, Welcome to Vice City. (PowerPyx)
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks when Chapter 3 ends, after the first two main missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life. (PowerPyx)
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks when Chapter 4 ends, after its final main mission, Starting From Zero. (PowerPyx)
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It is the gold for finishing the game's final mission, the same mission that closes Chapter 4, Starting From Zero, in PowerPyx's chapter breakdown. Finish the story and it pops. (PowerPyx)
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks during Chapter 2 when you complete the main mission Breakfast Run. (PowerPyx)
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks during Chapter 3 when you complete the main mission The Cartel Heist. (PowerPyx)
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks during Chapter 4 when you complete the main mission Child's Play. (PowerPyx)
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks during Chapter 4 when you complete the main mission Headliners. (PowerPyx)
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks during Chapter 4 when you complete the main mission VCIA Takedown. (PowerPyx)
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks during Chapter 5 when you complete the main mission Operation Savage Glory. (PowerPyx)
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: The hardest trophy in the set, and the gold that gates the platinum. The 100% checklist unlocks after the story under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion; progress you made during the story already counts. It is a forgiving list of 35 requirements, closer to 60% true completion: most collectible types are only partly required, and you only need 70 of 80 challenges. Nothing on it is missable, and everything can still be done in free-roam after the story. PowerPyx and The Gamers Hub both publish the same 35 requirements. (PowerPyx; The Gamers Hub)
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts in the game; the 100% checklist needs 300, so keep going past this trophy. There are four kinds: 130 stunt jumps over ramps, 202 flights under bridges, 40 knife flights between buildings, and 25 base jumps. Mix them freely and pick the quickest: PowerPyx calls the under-the-bridge flights the fastest. Track them on the map under Exploration, then Stunt Spots, or in the Progress menu under Activities, then Stunts. (PowerPyx)
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: The trophy tracker counts 9 activity types, listed under Touchpad, then Progress, then Activities: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball (scoring hoops), playing a video game, winning a car race, race challenge or Top Fun drone race, and performing a stunt. Do each one at least once. Most are introduced by the story or marked with blue icons when you unfog the map, and you will tick most of them off naturally while chasing the other trophies. (PowerPyx)
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: There are 12 shooting ranges with 42 challenges between them, and every one needs a gold medal. Gold medals here are the only medal type in the game that trophies care about: there are no mission gold medals. Work through the ranges one by one; the 100% checklist needs all 42 golds too, so this trophy and the checklist share the same work. (PowerPyx)
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations; there are 42 drone races in total across them. A win at each location is what counts, so a location is done once you have won there. The 100% checklist needs every drone race, so keep racing past this trophy. (PowerPyx)
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races across the game's 40 unique race locations. Each race location counts once, so spread your wins around instead of repeating one favourite track. Any race win counts, including race challenges and Top Fun drone races where the activity tracker counts them. (PowerPyx)
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 main mission Feng Shui, where you meet Cal, he will text you and mark a fishing spot with a purple icon on the map. Follow Cal's fishing questline and beat him in one of his fishing challenges. (PowerPyx)
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: There are 4 arcade games, called Video Games in-game: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind, and Bang For Your Buck. The first three are playable on the TV at home from Chapter 1; the fourth is on arcade machines around the world. To complete one you must finish all of its levels at least once; you do not need to beat every challenge. Pick whichever game you like best. (PowerPyx)
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's optional questline is marked automatically in Chapter 3 and is exclusive to Lucia: while playing as her you get a call from Andy, then a text with her home address in Belville. All of it is still available after the story. Finish her five quests: Climbing the Cellerichain (parts 1-3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label, and Puff Puff Pass. (PowerPyx)
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's optional questline is marked automatically in Chapter 1, a while after the main mission Island Dreams where you work for him; he then calls and is marked with a green KR icon in Key Lento. He sends you treasure diving: find underwater treasures at the purple chest icons, using the metal detector on the ocean floor, and bring them back. Clear 7 shipwrecks in total. He goes temporarily unavailable after Chapter 1 but returns in Chapter 2-3, so nothing here is missable. Track it under Progress, then Characters, then Kenton Rees. (PowerPyx)
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's optional questline is marked automatically after the Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break, at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. All of it is still available after the story. Finish his five quests: Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler, and Hometown Heroes. (PowerPyx)
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Strangers & Freaks are side questlines found in the open world, but only certain ones count: the game does not count Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy or Eddie toward this trophy. Confirmed counters include Kirk's Skunk Ape strand, Kyle's McKittrick Farm strand, Yago's street-racing strand, and Pilot Pete's delivery strand. Complete any 8 of the counted strands; more are still being discovered, and all remain available in free-roam after the story. Check your count in the trophy tracker. (PowerPyx)
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's optional questline, Randy's Wish List, is marked automatically after the Chapter 3 main mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal the Zorrusso for him and unlock the Key Cloner. He then wants 16 sports cars delivered to his garage in the west of Vice City, marked with a green RK icon. Scan high-end sports cars with the WAiNK app to see if one is on his list, then drive it back to him; delivering it in good condition pays more. Cars he marks for you appear in fixed spots, often parked outside hotels around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach. All of it can still be done after the story. (PowerPyx)
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's optional questline is marked automatically after the Chapter 3 main mission Here, Kitty Kitty, and is only available as Jason. Purple markers show Synthetic Labs in Vice City: destroy the labs in the quest Take Out Kitty Litter, and once enough are gone Tyrone gives you Spin On This, which shuts the labs down and unlocks the trophy. All of it is still available after the story. (PowerPyx)
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: There are 18 meditation spots across 10 locations. Meditating with both Jason and Lucia at a spot counts as +2, and you can track progress under Progress, then Collections, then Exploration, then Meditations. The final spot only opens once both characters can play together, after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break. POTENTIALLY MISSABLE: during Chapter 1, after the main mission Down to Earth, Lucia may talk about meditating in the kitchen in the morning and walk to the balcony. Follow her, choose Accept, and do the session. It is not marked as a meditation spot like the others, and it is unconfirmed whether the trophy needs it, but PowerPyx's author earned the trophy after doing it, so do it to be safe. This is the only trophy any published guide flags as possibly missable. (PowerPyx)
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret Vogel's optional questline is marked after the Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break: while playing as Jason you get a text from Bret marking his first quest, Veteran Hunted, in Lummox County. It is exclusive to Jason and still available after the story. Do his quest, then follow the hunting spots he marks with purple icons and bring the animals he requests back to him. His first quest gives you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69, retrievable from any Ammu-Nation weapon locker. Which exact animal unlocks the trophy is still UNCONFIRMED: PowerPyx notes it is still being confirmed, and there are 15 Target Decks to complete for the 100% checklist. (PowerPyx)
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Collectible cards are found around Leonida in 18 sets. Complete any 3 full sets. You do not need all 18: the 100% checklist only needs 15 of the 18 sets, so this trophy comes well before that. (PowerPyx)
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: WAiNK scans are objects in the world you scan by holding the WAiNK button: 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures, and Flusher Tags. There are more than 100 in total, so it does not matter which 100 you scan. Scan everything you pass while playing and this fills up on its own. (PowerPyx)
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: There are 80 challenges in the game and you only need 50 for this trophy; the 100% checklist needs 70 of 80, so it unlocks automatically on the way there. View and track them under Progress, then Challenges. Most complete naturally while you chase the other trophies; save this for late, then pick the easiest ones you have left. (PowerPyx)
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: You can only do this after the Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break, when Jason and Lucia can free-roam together; call your partner by holding the partner button. Raise a 4-star wanted level, then escape the red heat zone. PowerPyx's easiest route is driving through the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County, where cops struggle to follow and the helicopter cannot see you. It also pops naturally: bank vault robberies in Chapter 4 always trigger 4-star wanted levels, and the 100% checklist needs all 8 vaults. (PowerPyx)
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Only possible after the Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break, when both characters can play together. With your partner beside you, rob 3 robbery targets in a row (green icons on the map) while staying wanted the whole time: keep the red and blue flashing wanted level, not the red heat level. Wear an armored vest, carry sticky bombs and Zombix or Adrenaline for healing. A good spot is the 3 jewelry stores in the north of Vice City, after the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs. The unlock is delayed about half a minute after leaving the third shop; if it does not pop, hit a fourth. (PowerPyx)
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: The game has 557 vehicles at launch. Use the WAiNK app on your phone to scan vehicles: stand at a busy road and scan everything that passes; scanning is enough, you do not need to drive them. The 100% checklist needs 200 of the 277 base model vehicles scanned, so this trophy comes automatically on the way. Check your totals under Touchpad, then Progress, then Vehicles. (PowerPyx)
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Combat Focus is activated while aiming a firearm; it slows time, highlights weak spots, and drains the purple focus bar. You must kill or incapacitate 5 enemies in one use, which lasts only a few seconds. Buff your focus first with food, drinks, or washing up at home, and use Adrenaline to extend it. Line up 5 enemies, for example criminals at a gang operation, and finish them fast with an accurate full-auto rifle such as the Duke 556. It does not seem to work on soldiers, police, or civilians. Focus has 4 levels and grows as you play shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing, and land headshots, so it gets easier later. (PowerPyx)
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal one of the large passenger planes docked to a departure terminal at Vice City International Airport; it must be one connected to a passenger boarding bridge, not a plane parked on the airfield. The easiest is the one at terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence around the airfield, use the stairs by the boarding bridge to get inside, go upstairs to the cockpit, drive the plane back to the airstrip, take off, and fly at least 1 km away from the airport. The unlock is slightly delayed. (PowerPyx)
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Steal a military tank, a Rhino. They stand in the south of Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County: drive through the gate, or take the stunt jump by the south-east entrance, get in a tank, and shoot enemies until the trophy unlocks. (PowerPyx)
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 3 main mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs. That unlocks the Snap Gun, for silently lockpicking alarmed doors, and unlocks jewelry store robberies, marked with green icons in unfogged map areas. Break in through the back door with the Snap Gun instead of kicking it: kicking trips the alarm. Inside the backroom, find the note with the safe code and use it to loot the safe. A good target is Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City. (PowerPyx)
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe), which introduces bank vault robberies: tail a security van to a bank, wait for the guard to carry a briefcase of cash in and open the vault, then go in and rob it with your partner, handing off a bag to them. After that, pay Yasmani for security-van tips ($10,000 each) to mark more vans. There are 8 large bank jobs in total; you need any 5 for this trophy and all 8 for the 100% checklist. Each robbery gives an instant 4-star wanted level, so escape on a fast motorcycle and switch vehicles to become unrecognizable. A single vault can pay up to $205,000. (PowerPyx)
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: The same Chapter 4 optional mission that unlocks bank vaults, That's Where The Money Is…, unlocks this too: robbing a large bank's vault counts as robbing an armored truck. Or do it earlier: armored trucks drive around Vice City near banks, so block one's path, plant a sticky bomb on its back door, blow it open, and escape the red heat radius. Sticky bombs are sold at Ammu-Nation and found in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests. (PowerPyx)
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Fully unfog the whole map. The fastest way is by plane: fly over every area still covered in black fog until the entire map is visible. (PowerPyx)
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: There are 9 gangs and 39 illegal gang operations. For this trophy you only need one operation from each gang; the 100% checklist needs all 39, so it unlocks automatically on the way. Operations are marked with yellow icons when you go near them, and many are marked automatically from story progress. Track them under Progress, then Gangs, where each gang shows how many of its operations you have robbed. (PowerPyx)
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED: no published guide has pinned down how this trophy unlocks yet. The description points to a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach, so try the bars and viewpoints along Ocean Beach once they are open to you, and check back as guides update. Do not trust any method that cites no source. (PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown; Exophase/PSNProfiles for the official name and description.)
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED: no published guide has pinned down how this trophy unlocks yet. The description points to smashing out of a vehicle showroom, so the likely route is a showroom robbery or escape, but no source confirms a method, a showroom, or a mission yet. Check back as guides update. (PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown; Exophase/PSNProfiles for the official name and description.)
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: This unlocks by stealing all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling, a gang operation in Port Gellhorn. You go there during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling. Buy sticky bombs at an Ammu-Nation first: you need them to blow the safe. Inside, take the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique shotgun Gutterball Moreland 850 on the table in the north-east corner, and loot the safe in the north-east hallway. The trophy pops after you escape the police, not when you pick up the third item. If you miss one, wait for the robbery icon to respawn and go back for the rest; it is not missable. (PowerPyx)
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: Have maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. You can only start after the Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break, when you can switch between both characters. Check strength under Touchpad, then Jason & Lucia, then each character's Strength. Raise it by working out: buy a gym membership and always go together with both characters, so while one trains the other completes their training automatically. Gyms are filterable on the map under Activities. You can also work out at home after the story. (PowerPyx)
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile; you can see the count by clicking the trophy in the trophy list. Turn on criminal profile notifications in Settings, then UI, then HUD Notifications, then Criminal Profile, so a small demon face appears whenever an action counts. Professional actions are stealthy finishes and clean escapes; Hardened is incapacitating without killing; Violent is killing; Psycho is killing large numbers; Irredeemable is a permanent status from excessive violence. It happens passively across all other trophies, so do not farm it until everything else is done. (PowerPyx)
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED: no published guide has confirmed how this trophy unlocks. PowerPyx notes it is believed to be related to the Payday Loans store from the Prologue, but that is a belief, not a confirmed method. Try the Payday Loans stores and any second-attempt moments the game offers, and check back as guides update. (PowerPyx; Exophase/PSNProfiles for the official name and description.)
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED: no published guide has confirmed how this trophy unlocks. PowerPyx notes it is believed to be from a UFO questline, but that is a belief, not a confirmed method. Keep an eye on strange encounters and questlines as guides update, and do not trust any method that cites no source. (PowerPyx; Exophase/PSNProfiles for the official name and description.)
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED: no published guide has confirmed how this trophy unlocks. PowerPyx notes it is believed to be from kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle, a melee drive-by, but that is a belief, not a confirmed method. Try motorcycle melee kicks against enemies and check back as guides update. (PowerPyx; Exophase/PSNProfiles for the official name and description.)
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 3 main mission Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew), which unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer for laundering marked bills. Then rob banks and Payday Loans and bring the marked bills to a fence; Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The $250,000 is cumulative across robberies, not in one trip. It comes naturally from the robbery work for the 100% checklist, and bank vaults alone can pay up to $205,000 in a single robbery. (PowerPyx)
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend a total of $100,000 across all shop types. The fastest way is the expensive stuff: guns, car mods, and tattoos. The game has 14 mod shops, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays, 24 Ammu-Nations, 67 clothing stores, 17 footwear stores, 18 hair and beauty salons, 11 tattoo studios, and 15 electronics stores, so normal play plus a few big purchases gets you there. (PowerPyx)
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: There are 8 purchasable garages, plus 4 story-related ones you do not need for this trophy. Together the 8 cost $160,000. They become available after the Chapter 2 main mission Daily Driver (Steal the Crawler for Moses), when the Vice City Real Estate app is installed on your phone; buy them through the app. Robberies are the quickest way to raise the money, especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3 and 4. (PowerPyx)
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: The Scooter Bros app is installed on your phone after the Chapter 2 main mission Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses). It lets you register stolen vehicles and have them delivered to you anywhere. Buy garages first, since each garage adds parking spots for registered vehicles, then drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn and use Respray and Register in his garage. At first he only accepts vehicles without trackers; from Chapter 3 you can also register cars with standard trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registering costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes. (PowerPyx)
trophies.name: On the Spot
